acceptable_paraphrases: trapezoid: none | property B | no | not applicable | c | C | - | B | B depends on C | property B is dependent on C | B varies as a function of C
critical_errors: Incorrect identification of the shape (not trapezium)
Presence of any non-zero values in 'none' fields
Absence or incorrect representation of 'B varies with C'
misconceptions: Assuming a constant B regardless of the value of C
Incorrectly indicating any property as 'none' when it should be present or vary with C
Misidentifying property relationships (e.g., stating B is independent of C)
grading_notes: Ensure that all required concepts are clearly stated. Acceptance of paraphrases allows for different phrasings but maintains the core meaning.
